name: release
wording: The operator makes merged work available to the project's users, by the project's own means, the one act no agent performs: merging a pull request joins a task's change to the project's shared work, and release delivers that work to its users.
reason: The operator, 2026-10-15: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure; each role is defined by what it receives and hands over, each handover states what it must contain, and established practice is named rather than restated. Merging a pull request now joins work to the project; the cut's integration is gone.
